name: Xoi ca ro
summary: Sticky rice with fried cá rô đồng, fried shallot, rau răm, and mùi tàu, eaten hot. The fish fat turns the grains glossy and deep yellow, and the fish is sweet and firm.
origin: Nam Định, on Thế giới tiếp thị, 12 September 2022.
texture: The rice stays chewy and does not fall apart. The fish is sweet and firm, and the fat makes the grains glossy.
howToEat: Hot. Thế giới tiếp thị names it as a cold-weather dish.
seoTitle: Xoi ca ro — sticky rice and fried cá rô
seoDescription: Sticky rice with fried cá rô đồng and shallot in Nam Định, eaten hot in cold weather.
